name: @zframes/provider-sec-th
description: Free, no-key zframes data provider for SEC Thailand's published statistics CSVs: SET/mai market capitalisation by industry group and sector, the mutual-fund industry's asset allocation, each exchange's annual key statistics, and the bond market's annual statistics and quarterly issuance (industry-market-cap, fund-industry-allocation, exchange-key-stats, bond-market-stats, bond-issuance capabilities).
author: Zentry
